title: An assay to evaluate the capacity of cholesterol acceptors using BODIPY-cholesterol in cells
protocol: Aspirate culture medium from cells.
Rinse cells once with warm DMEM/F-12.
Aspirate DMEM/F-12.
Add 5 mL of room temperature accutase to the cells.
Incubate for 10 minutes in a tissue culture incubator (37°C, 5% CO2).
Gently tap the sides of the flask to lift the cells off.
Add 5 mL of warm culture medium and pipette up and down several times with a 10-mL serological pipette.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15-mL falcon tube.
Pipette up and down in the falcon tube to further dissociate cell clumps.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation at 300 × g for 3 minutes.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL of culture medium.
Pipette up and down with a 1 mL pipette approximately 30 times to ensure single-cell suspension.
Avoid introducing bubbles during resuspension.
Take 10 μL of the cell suspension and mix thoroughly with 10 μL of trypan blue.
Load 10 μL of the mixture onto a disposable cell counting slide.
Count cells manually or using an automated cell counter.
Resuspend cells to a final density of 0.1 × 10^6 cells/mL in culture medium.
Plate 25 × 10^3 cells per well in a 48-well plate (250 μL per well).
Gently shake the plate to distribute the cells evenly across each well.
Incubate overnight at 37°C, 5% CO2 to allow cells to settle and attach.
Dilute cholesterol at 10 mg/mL in chloroform.
Store diluted cholesterol at -20°C for up to one year.
Dilute TopFluor Cholesterol (BODIPY-cholesterol) at 1 mg/mL in DMSO.
Aliquot BODIPY-cholesterol and store aliquots at -20°C for several months.
Prepare MβCD at 20 mM in DMEM/F-12, no phenol red by dissolving 66 mg in 2.5 mL of medium.
In a glass test tube, add 9.75 μL of cholesterol solution to achieve a final concentration of 0.1 mM in 2.5 mL of BODIPY-cholesterol stock.
Evaporate solvent under N2 to form a lipid film on the walls of the glass vial.
Resuspend the lipid film in DMEM containing 20 mM MβCD.
Sonicate the suspension for 30 min at 37°C.
Incubate the suspension for 3 h at 37°C prior to centrifugation.
Measure and record fluorescence of 10× BODIPY-cholesterol.
Dissolve TopFluor Cholesterol (BODIPY-cholesterol) at 1 mg/mL in DMSO to achieve a final concentration of 0.05 mM.
Dry the lipid mixture under N2 flow until it forms a thin film.
Resuspend the dried lipid film in 20 mM MβCD in DMEM/F-12 medium.
Sonicate the lipid suspension at 37°C for 30 minutes to promote solubilization.
Incubate the sonicated lipid suspension in an orbital shaker at 250 rpm, 37°C for 3 hours.
Sonicate the lipid suspension again at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge the lipid suspension at 4,696 × g for 5 minutes to pellet non-solubilized BODIPY-cholesterol.
Transfer the supernatant carefully to a capped glass vial wrapped in foil.
Measure the fluorescence of the final 10× BODIPY cholesterol solution using a plate reader with an excitation wavelength set at 482 nm.
Set the emission wavelength to 515 nm.
Keep a record of the fluorescence measured in RFU.
Store 10× BODIPY-Cholesterol at 4°C for up to one week.
Check the fluorescence of 10× BODIPY-cholesterol with a plate reader (ex: 482 nm; em: 515 nm).
Ensure that cyclodextrins are included in the preparation of 10× BODIPY-Cholesterol.
Dilute 10× BODIPY-cholesterol to 1× BODIPY-cholesterol in DMEM/F-12 supplemented with Sandoz at 2 μg/mL.
Aspirate the culture medium from the cells.
Add 250 μL of 1× BODIPY-cholesterol solution to each experimental well.
Incubate for 1 hour in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Remove 1× BODIPY-cholesterol from the cells.
Rinse cells twice with DMEM/F-12 supplemented with 2 μg/mL Sandoz 58-035.
Add 250 μL of equilibration medium per well.
Incubate overnight (∼16 h) in an incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Dilute ApoA1 to 10 μg/mL in DMEM/F-12 supplemented with 2 μg/mL Sandoz.
Aspirate the equilibration medium from each well.
Add 250 μL of 10 μg/mL apoA1 solution to each well for treatment, in triplicate.
Add 250 μL of DMEM/F-12 supplemented with 2 μg/mL Sandoz to control wells without apoA1, in triplicate.
Incubate the treated and control cells for 4 h at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Transfer medium from each well to a 96-well plate.
Rinse cells once with PBS.
Add 250 μL of RIPA lysis buffer containing protease inhibitor to cells and incubate at 4°C on a shaker for 20 min.
Transfer 95 μL of culture medium from each well to a 96-well black fluorescence plate in duplicate.
Measure BODIPY-cholesterol in the medium using a plate reader (ex: 482 nm; em: 515 nm).
Transfer RIPA cell lysate from each well to a 96-well plate and centrifuge for 20 min at 2,000 × g.
Transfer 95 μL of culture medium from the lysates to a 96-well black fluorescence plate in duplicate.
Measure BODIPY-cholesterol in the cell lysate using a plate reader (ex: 482 nm; em: 515 nm).
Ensure the presence of Sandoz, the acetyl-choline esterase inhibitor, at all steps.
Up-regulate ABCA1 with 0.3 mM cAMP to facilitate cholesterol efflux.
